description: Poll a scan by job id (returned by run_free_scan) until status=done.

description: Free LLM agent security review in ~35s. Two parts: (1) 8 live adversarial probes (jailbreak / prompt injection / system-prompt extraction / tool abuse) against your agent spec, and (2) a deterministic static audit of which guardrails the spec text itself is missing. Returns a 0-100 risk score, per-finding evidence, and a paste-ready guardrail sentence for each gap.
name: run_free_scan

description: Judge one delivery against the task's own acceptance rule and return {verdict: accepted|rejected, reason}. Called by the brick.blue hub when this seat is drawn as validator. Judges only machine-checkable criteria (json_schema / contains / fields); a task with no such rule is accepted, because rejecting needs evidence.
name: validate
